name: Peregrine Falcon Dive
description: Vertical stoop attack from altitude. Fastest animal dive (~320 km/h). Produces vertical flock-split: the flock cleaves on a vertical axis as the falcon stoops through, then reforms beneath.

preyResponse.description: The fastest flock response is vertical compression then vertical split. The flock flattens (2D sheet) as the stoop begins, then splits vertically as the falcon passes through.

notes: Peregrine falcons (Falco peregrinus) are the fastest animals in a dive, reaching 389 km/h. They target the outermost birds of a murmuration and rely on the confusion effect being overcome by sheer speed. The stoop creates a vertical 'corridor of emptiness' that reforms within 1-2 seconds.
